reviews.name: Mateo R.
reviews.text: Diego does my whole beard and haircut and I always leave looking fresh for days. Consistent, talented, and chill.

reviews.name: Adrian G.
reviews.text: He works with my curly hair which a lot of fade barbers aren't great at. Diego adapts the technique perfectly. Really impressed.

reviews.name: Felix M.
reviews.text: Good barber and easy to get an appointment with. The lineup was super sharp and clean.

reviews.name: Sergio N.
reviews.text: I've lived in the Richmond for three years and Diego is definitely the neighborhood's best barber. Always leaves me right.

barbers.name: Kenji Watanabe
barbers.bio: Japantown precision barber trained in Tokyo and San Francisco with 12 years of experience at Pacific Cuts. Specializing in fine and thick Asian hair — cuts that frame the face perfectly and require minimal styling.

services.name: Japanese Taper
services.description: Precision taper with scissor-over-comb technique

services.name: Texture Cut
services.description: Layered cut for natural movement and texture

services.name: Classic Men's Cut
services.description: Traditional short back and sides with styled top

services.name: Scalp Treatment & Cut
services.description: Relaxing scalp treatment followed by precision cut

reviews.name: Hiroshi T.
reviews.text: Kenji is the only barber I trust with my fine Japanese hair. He uses techniques from Tokyo that nobody else in SF applies. Flawless every time.

reviews.name: Daniel W.
reviews.text: The scalp treatment and cut was incredible. I left feeling completely refreshed. Kenji's experience shows in every detail.

reviews.name: Kevin N.
reviews.text: Great taper, very precise. The shop has a calm, zen atmosphere. Priced well for the quality.

reviews.name: Tom S.
reviews.text: Thick Asian hair is notoriously hard to cut well. Kenji handles it like breathing. My cut looks good for weeks.

reviews.name: Alex Y.
reviews.text: Been coming to Pacific Cuts for 3 years. Kenji remembers your preferences and always delivers. Consistent excellence.

reviews.name: Brian C.
reviews.text: Clean shop in Japantown, excellent barber. The texture cut gave my hair a life I didn't know it had.

barbers.name: Fatima Al-Hassan
barbers.bio: Marin's premier loctician and natural hair stylist. Trained in Dakar and Paris, I bring a global perspective to locs and protective styles. Clients travel from across the Bay and beyond for a reason.

services.name: Loc Maintenance
services.description: Full retwist, palm rolling, and styling

services.name: Starter Locs
services.description: Initial installation with full consultation and aftercare guide

services.name: Loc Extensions
services.description: Extensions to add length and fullness to existing locs

services.name: Natural Styling Session
services.description: Wash, condition, and natural style for coily hair

reviews.name: Layla A.
reviews.text: Fatima is a true master. I've seen locticians all over the Bay and nobody approaches her skill level. My locs look like art.

reviews.name: Yasmin B.
reviews.text: She speaks Arabic and French, which made communication so natural. The result was even more beautiful than I imagined.

reviews.name: Sophia D.
reviews.text: I drove from San Jose and would do it again without hesitation. Fatima's technique is truly at another level.

reviews.name: Mona K.
reviews.text: She started my loc journey six months ago and my locs are thriving. The guidance she gives beyond the chair is invaluable.

reviews.name: Halima N.
reviews.text: Beautiful natural styling session. She was thorough, gentle, and my hair was glowing when I left. Worth the trip to Sausalito.

reviews.name: Nadia C.
reviews.text: Her Dakar-trained technique is unmistakable. Every loc is placed with intention. I've been recommending her to everyone I know.
